name: What is the typical cost range for an accessibility bathroom remodel?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost range for an accessibility bathroom remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of an accessibility bathroom remodel can vary significantly based on the scope of work and materials chosen. Minor updates, such as installing grab bars and a raised toilet, might range from a few hundred to a couple of thousand dollars. More extensive projects, like a full roll-in shower conversion, widening doorways, or reconfiguring the layout, could range from $10,000 to over $25,000. Factors like fixture selection and structural changes influence the final price.
acceptedAnswer.description: Accessibility bathroom remodel costs vary; minor updates are hundreds to a few thousand dollars, while extensive projects can be over $10,000 depending on scope.
